title: SAFE vs RISKY
subtitle: $1,000 SINCE 2015
caption: $1,000 in 2015 · indicative values, not financial advice
outro:
Follow for the money
nobody explains.
vo: In twenty fifteen, you had one thousand dollars and a choice. Play it safe in a savings account, and today it would be worth barely eleven hundred. Gold would double it. The S and P three x. Apple would make it ten thousand. But Bitcoin, the risky bet everyone laughed at, would have turned that same thousand dollars into over a hundred and fifty thousand. The price of playing it safe has never been clearer. Where was your money? Follow, for the money nobody explains.
